description: Synthetic benchmark for structural-search discipline. It tests return, constraint checking, corroboration, falsifiability, and classification; it does not test open-ended model creativity or establish general search superiority.

cases.target_problem: Can a fixed computational host support materially different task-relative forms?

analogies.invariant: fixed substrate can expose different operational geometry under task demand
analogies.prediction: same host can have different feasible task sets under different configurations
analogies.falsifier: reconfiguration never changes task feasibility on a fixed host

cases.target_problem: Should host capability be treated as a static declaration or an empirically calibrated operational map?

analogies.invariant: declared or inherited body structure becomes operationally useful only through action consequence calibration
analogies.prediction: measured host behavior should update future scheduling decisions
analogies.falsifier: experience never improves or changes host scheduling relative to declarations

cases.target_problem: Should a scheduler optimize the best morphology now or the trajectory of morphology changes?

analogies.invariant: when transitions have cost, the best immediate state can differ from the best state trajectory
analogies.prediction: bounded lookahead or hysteresis can beat repeated greedy reshaping
analogies.falsifier: transition-aware policies never improve any admissible workload trajectory

cases.target_problem: May repeated successful autonomous action create broader authority?

analogies.invariant: a capable protective subsystem can autonomously exclude perceived threats
analogies.prediction: a repeatedly successful subsystem should be permitted to widen its own action envelope
analogies.falsifier: target architecture requires authority to remain externally bounded regardless of competence

cases.target_problem: Can a shared capability be loaded once and serve multiple task morphologies?

analogies.invariant: multiple workflows can depend on one shared resident resource rather than duplicate it
analogies.prediction: coexisting task footprints should count shared resident modules once
analogies.falsifier: shared modules necessarily incur full duplicate residency per task
